name: ClashDoctor Qloo coverage probe — fixed artist set
purpose: Determine empirically whether Qloo returns enough artist resolution and taste-tag coverage for ClashDoctor's similarity and scheduling claims. This file is human-authored input, not Qloo output.

label_definitions.established: Internationally documented acts with a long catalogue and broad editorial coverage. Selected to span distinct genres and eras.
label_definitions.emerging: Independent or regional-language acts whose international catalogue coverage is expected to be thinner; several are well known inside India. 'Emerging' is a hypothesis about data coverage and a description of independent/regional status, not a talent or popularity ranking. No popularity numbers are assumed anywhere in this file.

human_judgment_note: Expected groups and expected similar/different pairs below are editorial judgments from public genre descriptions. They are used only as sanity checks. They are not ground truth, and no pair in this file is evidence of shared audience, ticket demand or attendance.

expected_similar_pairs.rationale: Both UK acts in the alternative/art-rock and trip-hop lineage; overlapping alternative-rock vocabulary is widely documented.
Both canonical jazz figures who recorded together.
Same Hindustani classical tradition and family lineage.
Both Indian electronic acts with a dance-floor orientation.
Both Indian progressive bands fusing rock with Carnatic/Kerala musical material.

expected_different_pairs.rationale: Icelandic post-rock versus Indian bass/electronic dance music.
Hindustani classical sitar versus French electronic/disco.
Carnatic violin versus US indie rock.
West Coast hip-hop versus instrumental post-rock.
